scores.evidence: “The subgroup pattern was discovered through exploratory analysis.” Explicitly preserves the finding as exploratory.
“motivating the post hoc hypothesis that [hypothesis]” Identifies the hypothesis as post hoc rather than prespecified.
“This hypothesis requires independent confirmation.” Explicitly requires independent confirmation and proposes follow-up on untouched data.
“The second plan omits the experiment-type field; its status is unknown.” Marks the legacy plan’s experiment type as unknown.
“Do not infer confirmatory status from the omission.” Explicitly avoids assuming the legacy plan was confirmatory.
